environment.execution: serial synchronous calls in one Node process; measured elapsed time, not isolated CPU time

source.currentTargetAnalysis: post-hoc comparison of recorded per-call maxima only; no rerun or end-to-end guarantee

units.loadRatioMax: fraction of assumed safety-adjusted allowable top load
units.extraFit: number of remaining SKU types with a sampled feasible candidate
units.p95Ms: mean of per-trial P95 in algorithm summaries; per-trial P95 in rows

definitions.cog: sum(mass * box geometric center) / total cargo mass; uniform mass distribution within each box; pallet mass excluded
definitions.voidLiters: palletWidth * palletDepth * usedHeight / 1e6 - boxVolume / 1e6; includes all unoccupied envelope space, not trapped or inaccessible void
definitions.loadRatioMax: max(loadAbove / (maxLoadKg * strengthFactor / loadSafetyFactor)); assumed synthetic strengths; unknown strengths yield null
definitions.extraFit: sampled wider residual candidate check, not an optimality certificate
definitions.latency: recorded wall-clock planner calls only; auditing, sensing, communication and real robot control excluded

limitations: Static factors describe different loaded product mixtures and quantities; no arbitrary combined score is used.
Horizontal balance and low cargo CoG do not establish vibration resistance or transport safety.
Source retained its original 8-second per-call limit. Current 10-12 second targets are post-hoc comparisons only.
Multiple buffer retries may occur after one placement, so individual calls within a target do not establish an end-to-end robot cycle.
Sampled extraFit=0 does not prove global optimality or absence of any feasible packing.
MCTS is not included in this five-algorithm artifact.
